rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: 90-minute proctored coding test (HackerRank/SHL), typically 3 DSA problems of rising difficulty: arrays/strings, greedy/DP, graph or matrix traversal.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 1
rounds.description: PS/DS round, ~1 hour, 2 DSA problems on a shared doc or editor; explain brute force to optimal, dry run, complexity.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 2
rounds.description: Second PS/DS round, 1-2 medium/hard problems (DP, trees, graphs), sometimes project discussion.

rounds.name: Hiring Manager
rounds.description: Behavioral/background discussion; not always held for 2-month interns.

rounds.name: Online Assessment
rounds.description: 90-minute test with 3 DSA problems (medium-hard, story-style statements) on SHL/HackerRank.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 1
rounds.description: PSDS-1: 45-60 min, 2 DSA problems on Google Doc/whiteboard, multiple approaches and complexity expected.

rounds.name: Technical Interview 2
rounds.description: PSDS-2: 60 min, 2-3 DSA problems (DP, graphs, sliding window), sometimes a small LLD question.

rounds.name: Hiring Manager
rounds.description: Projects, behavioral and culture-fit questions, sometimes CS fundamentals or a small design problem.

rounds.name: Machine Coding
rounds.description: ~30 min requirement walkthrough + 90 min coding a demoable in-memory system, then 30-45 min code review/evaluation.

rounds.name: System Design
rounds.description: LLD/HLD design round: entities, schema, APIs, services.

rounds.name: Hiring Manager
rounds.description: Project deep dive plus behavioral questions.
